why: rc33: one-line fit, settings rows grow, size slider reaches every game text

args.notes:
WoWFA Forever 1.0.0-rc33 (test build, built by wowfa2 CI).

Fix: with a big font size the Persian objective lines in the quest list (map, key M) and the tracker wrapped and ran into the next line. A line we write now stays on one line: if it is wider than its row it is made smaller until it fits. After a size slider moves, the game writes the quest list again so its rows get the new height.
Fix: the settings window. Rows with a two-line label or description overlapped the next row. Every page is now stacked from the real height of its texts.
New: with "Persian font in the whole game" on, the General font size slider now also scales the game's own texts (English too), and a new slider "game text size (percent)" in General sets them on top of that. The chat keeps its own slider.
Fix: the original font of a line is now also remembered from its font object, so English lines go back exactly to the game's font.
Includes rc7 to rc32.
